code: best face code of orders 0-3 (data/boundaryHarmonicTraining1888Hold301FaceMinus60Minus5/order3_restart08.npz): a0 0.8171, a1 0.2504, a2 0.4336, a3 -0.2800
knockout: the chosen coefficients set to 0, a0 never; held values clipped to [0, 2]

measures.eyeCoverage: mean over the two 2x2 eyes of the share of their cells that are dark (Vmem < -34.6 mV)
measures.mouthCoverage: share of the 3 mouth cells (row 8, columns 4-6) that are dark
measures.noseCoverage: share of the 3 nose cells (rows 4-6, column 5) that are dark
measures.cheekDark: dark cells among the interior non-feature cells in columns 1-2 and 8-9 (rows 1-9)
measures.bridgeDark: dark cells in row 7, columns 4-6, between the nose and the mouth
measures.mouthSeparate: 1 if the mouth's dark cells form a region that holds no nose cell, else 0
measures.spuriousDark: dark interior cells outside the 14 feature cells

moments.trainedMoment: iteration 2173, the trained code's best moment
moments.ownBestMoment: the knocked-out code's own lowest balanced RMS, iterations 301-2999

predictions.a1: eyeMinusMouth falls: the eyes lose their stronger push relative to the mouth
predictions.a2: cheekDark rises: the sides are no longer kept light
predictions.a3: the mouth merges with the nose: bridgeDark rises and mouthSeparate falls
predictions.combinations: the single effects add: each knocked-out order shows its own predicted change

controls: for each knockout, 20 random changes to a1-a3 moving the ring's held values by the same RMS amount; a role is supported when the knockout moves its predicted measure beyond the controls' 5th-95th percentile range in the predicted direction
retraining: a1 fixed at 0 with a0, a2, a3 retrained; a2 fixed at 0 with a0, a1, a3 retrained (population 64, 10 restarts, 100 generations, ceiling 1.3). An order is necessary for its role when the retrained code still shows that role's predicted change
